metadata.purpose: Record attributable and current policy positions; party proposals are not enacted government policy.
metadata.caveat: Proposals and costings must be checked against original party budget documents. Press summaries are secondary sources.

positions.policy_area: Housing, health, cost of living, education, disability
positions.position_summary: Alternative Budget 2027 prioritises targeted child and energy supports, expanded public and affordable housing, childcare, health capacity and income-tax indexation.
positions.proposal_text: Proposals include a €400 targeted energy credit, 6,000 public childcare places, more than 6,000 social and affordable homes annually with a stated public-build target of 22,000, a second-tier Child Benefit, weekly welfare increases, expanded GP care and disability supports.
positions.costing_source: Party budget publication; verify detailed costing tables in original document
positions.status: Party proposal — not enacted government policy

positions.policy_area: Housing, health, taxation, childcare, disability, cost of living
positions.position_summary: Alternative Budget 2027 proposes targeted household supports and long-term public capacity investment.
positions.proposal_text: Proposals include a €400 targeted energy credit, €300 monthly childcare fee reduction, additional State-led social and affordable housing and modular home factories, a €1bn-plus Sláintecare and health staffing investment, and a 2% wealth tax on assets over €5m.
positions.costing_source: Party Alternative Budget 2027; verify detailed costing tables in original document
positions.status: Party proposal — not enacted government policy

positions.policy_area: Housing, taxation, cost of living, health, public services
positions.position_summary: Budget 2027 proposals reported in October 2026 emphasise household cost supports, tax changes and increased social and affordable housing.
positions.proposal_text: Reported proposals include a €500 Everyday Essentials Card for one million lower-income households, €400 electricity credit, USC changes, increased social and affordable housing investment and a doubling of the renters tax credit. Treat these as a press-reported summary pending source-document extraction.
positions.costing_source: Secondary reporting of party budget; original party costing document should be linked before final assessment

positions.position_summary: Budget 2027 proposals reported in October 2026 emphasise direct public provision, price interventions and higher taxation on wealth and excess profits.
positions.proposal_text: Reported proposals include expanded State housing construction, household energy credits, abolishing energy standing charges and price caps. Treat these as a press-reported summary pending original source-document extraction.
positions.costing_source: Secondary reporting; obtain original party document and costings
